card.name: Words just before "significance"
card.fires_on: The word right before "significance", such as clinical, unknown or uncertain, in phrases like "of unknown clinical significance". Also the start of the word significance when it is split.

modes.label: Qualifier of significance
modes.description: Words like unknown, uncertain or clinical that sit before "significance" in findings of unclear meaning.
modes.example: This change is of unknown<< clinical>> significance.

modes.label: Split word significance
modes.description: The first piece of "significance" when it is split, in a book title.
modes.example: The American Revolution in New York: Its Political, Social and Economic<< Sign>>ificance.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like bearing, bears and clinical, as in "bearing significance".
